summary: Frontend-only UI validation of Obserra Cyber Crisis Commander (/app/cyber-crisis-commander). Login (cookie session admin) works. Page renders with header title, EXECUTIVE INCIDENT COMMAND badge, v1.0.0 version badge (crisis-version-badge). All 6 KPI cards + 4 Mission Control panels + all 9 tab testids present. End-to-end flows verified: New Case creates CRISIS-0001, phase/status selects persist (Detection->Triage, Open->Contained). Decision Room: Add Decision creates ACT-0001, Approve button flips status to Approved. Containment & Recovery: Add Action creates ACT-0002 and advance moves Open->Executing->Verified with progress bar updating. Timeline & Evidence: Add Event persists newest-first. Business Impact / Control Failures / Defensibility tabs render live-feed data cleanly with no error boundaries. Executive Briefing 'Generate Cyber Crisis Executive Brief' triggers a real PDF download (obserra-cyber-crisis-executive-brief.pdf). AI Analyst (AIExplain) and Obserrian Advisor (AIInsight) panels render. Walkthrough opens (crisis-tour) with Next/Back stepping and spotlight highlighting each tab.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec required data-testids crisis-form-severity, crisis-form-commander, crisis-form-sponsor, crisis-form-summary are NOT present in the modal. Only crisis-form-title + crisis-create-case-submit exist. Case is still created successfully with defaults, but rich metadata cannot be entered by the user via testids in the modal.

Spec required data-testids crisis-decision-approver and crisis-decision-impacts are NOT present. Only crisis-decision-room, crisis-decision-title, crisis-decision-submit exist. Decision still created and approve flow works.

action_items: Add missing form testids (or fields) on New Crisis modal: crisis-form-severity, crisis-form-commander, crisis-form-sponsor, crisis-form-summary as described in the review request.
Add missing form testids (or fields) on Add Decision modal: crisis-decision-approver, crisis-decision-impacts.
critical_code_review_comments: Decision/Action share the same ACT-#### id namespace and the same crisis-approve-<id> / crisis-action-advance-<id> testid prefixes — while functional, this could cause selector ambiguity in future tests; consider distinct id prefixes (DEC-#### vs ACT-####).
New-Case modal advertises detailed intake in spec but ships with title-only field; ensure UX matches the documented feature set.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all flows work; two forms are missing several documented fields/testids)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 crisis case (CRISIS-0001, TEST_ Ransomware Case A), 1 decision (ACT-0001 TEST_ Isolate segment, Approved), 1 action (ACT-0002 TEST_ Contain host, advanced to Verified via previous run then Open on this fresh case), 1 manual timeline event (TEST_ Playbook activated). No delete-case UI is exposed (expected). Main agent may clean up via backend if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route /app/cyber-crisis-commander. Login as admin (jblan2026@gmail.com/Obserra2026!). Auth is cookie-based, no bearer. All primary flows validated in iteration_131. Only gaps are missing testids on New-Case and Add-Decision modals; fixing those unlocks full-fidelity form testing. PDF export works via /report/pdf (studio). Walkthrough steps through all tabs; ensure onboarding advisor toast doesn't overlap Finish button in future.
rca of the issue: Missing form testids are a spec-vs-implementation gap in CyberCrisisCommander.jsx new-case and add-decision dialogs. Not a runtime bug — creates still succeed with defaults on the backend.
